rows.grounds: accusative plural masculine of kumbha, object of the ritual action
instrumental plural neuter of vastra, means of wrapping
absolutive of sam-ā-veṣṭ, indicating completed wrapping before the next action
compound adjective in accusative plural masculine modifying the pots

items.question: How are the pots to be wrapped and adorned with gold lotuses?
premises: Pots are endowed with gold lotuses.
items.inference: The ritual pots must be clothed and ornamented before installation.
uncertainties: Exact ritual function of the gold lotus is not specified.
items.plain_english: Wrap the pots with cloths and provide them with gold lotuses.
